description: Lists the loans where a named tenant is among the three largest at the property, with balance, status, coverage and, where it is the largest tenant, the lease end. With no tenant it lists the tenants with the most CMBS exposure. Use it to measure exposure to one tenant; use search_loans with tenant set to filter a wider search. No match returns an empty list.

limit.description: Tenants or loans listed: up to 25 free, 400 with a Pro or Team key

name: tenant_exposure
title: Tenant exposure
